notes.note: superset(1, *) directly violates restriction e) (member resolves to AnyValueOrNone); Titan does not implement this check.
Mirrors the 'causes an error' case of EXAMPLE 1 (superset(1,2,3) length(2..7)); Titan does not check length attributes against superset size.
A template(omit) parameter used as superset member does not obey the present restriction (15.8); Titan does not check template restrictions of superset members.
Chose the 'specific value or combined template' reading (as for SuperSet/complement): an all from template that is AnyValue as a whole is rejected.
Uses a length restriction on a subset member (omit is covered by the SuperSet counterpart); Titan does not implement this check.
subset(1, *) directly violates restriction e) (member resolves to AnyValueOrNone); Titan does not implement this check.
Mirrors the 'causes an error' case of EXAMPLE 1 (subset(1,2,3) length(0..4)); Titan does not check length attributes against subset size.
A template(omit) parameter used as subset member does not obey the present restriction (15.8); Titan does not check template restrictions of subset members.
Chose the reading that a template which is omit as a whole shall not be used as top-level template of a receive operation (compile-time reject); Titan does not check it.

Hard to test: the decoding target type carries the predefined variant "UTF-16" (27.5), value is serialized as UTF-8 and decmatch("UTF-8") must still match, showing the parameter overrides the variant. Titan rejects the variant as unrelated to its JSON codec, a Titan codec limitation; encode "JSON" is tool-specific.
Chose the runtime reading: the invalid format "UTF-7" is only known at runtime, so matching causes a test case error. The static case is covered by B.01.02.09_test_010.

decmatch tests rely on tool codecs selected by encode attributes ("RAW", "JSON"), which are not standardized; the matching semantics themselves are standard. Applies to all B.01.02.09 executable tests.
